title: Q1/Q2 n=10 pilot - consolidated clean results
notes: Condition values are metric means by split, method, token budget, and question type; valid counts are included.
Method summaries equally average available split-budget-question-type cells and are exploratory, not inferential statistics.
Only the approved n=10 generation reports and complete n=10 retrieval reports are included. Smoke trials, failed earlier attempts, logs, and error records are excluded.
